points: Stage-2 time is one call. PalletPoseNode::on_pair builds the class-matched DetectionCandidate vector (source_index is the slot in Detection2DArray), then select_detection runs one std::max_element. Default strategy highest_confidence breaks ties by area_px; largest_area breaks ties by score. detector postprocess caps that list at max_detections 10, so the ranking is a few comparisons. estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2 then runs once on that bbox, and only that source_index is forwarded as instance_id. publish_pose writes PalletPoseStamped (yaw, face normal, plane_inlier_ratio, n_face_points, chamfer_cost_m, input_rgb_stamp, input_depth_stamp) with no extra geometry. A second estimate per leftover candidate would repeat the chamfer grids below; ordering the existing vector and copying those source indexes onto the message does not.

The measured geometry is two_stage_chamfer_search_v2 on the free pose, then usually two_stage_chamfer_search_v2_with_prior. Free coarse is 21 x 31 x 31 = 20181 evaluations (theta +/-10 deg at 1 deg, xy +/-0.15 m at 0.01 m). Free fine is 13 x 25 x 25 = 8125 (theta +/-1.2 deg at 0.2 deg, xy +/-0.012 m at 0.001 m). confidence = clamp((0.020 - free_cost) / (0.020 - 0.006), 0, 1) and lambda_eff = prior_lambda 3.0 * (1 - confidence). The prior search is skipped only when lambda_eff <= lambda_floor 0.05, which is free_cost <= 0.006233333333333334 m. The prior search is centered on the pi-resolved PCA init_pose, not on free_pose. Prior coarse is 21 x 21 x 21 = 9261 (xy +/-0.10 m at 0.01 m, same 21 yaw steps) plus another 8125 fine evaluations. Those four grids are 45692 evaluations. Each of the four stage searches also costs its seed once before the grid, choose_pi_ambiguous_pose adds two chamfer_cost_v2 calls, the anchor cost adds one and always runs before the lambda_eff branch, and the post-prior data-only chamfer_cost_v2 adds one: 45700 evaluations when the prior runs. OpenMP schedule(static) splits that count across threads; the critical section runs once per thread and does not drop evaluations.

Each evaluation is O(N log N) with N = 182. cached_prototype builds the contour once for the default 1.20 x 0.14 m face and two 0.47 x 0.10 m pockets at contour_spacing_m 0.03: n = max(2, ceil(length/spacing)+1) per edge with the endpoint omitted, 94 + 44 + 44. rotate_proto_into writes proto * R.transpose() into ChamferTls.rotated only when theta changes. chamfer_cost_from_rotated still does tls.translated = rotated and adds (tx, ty) on every pose, sample_bilinear_into setConstant-fills all N distances then bilinear-samples them, and trimmed_mean_from_distances assign-copies those N doubles into tls.sorted and std::sorts all N although trim_fraction 0.10 sums only ceil(0.9*N) = 164. The bilinear reads are column-major points(i, 0) and points(i, 1), a stride of N doubles, into a distance image that is not reused across poses. At 45700 evaluations the translation copy is 133078400 bytes and the sort copy is 66539200 bytes, before the sorts.

The image work in front of that grid runs once per posed detection. depth_image_to_meters convertTo-copies the whole depth frame to a new CV_32FC1; camera.yaml depth is 640x480 and 16UC1 is scaled by depth_scale 0.001. build_bbox_mask zero-fills a 1920x1080 mask and erodes it erode_px 2 times with a 3x3 kernel. sample_face_points still scans every depth pixel, 640*480 = 307200, doing a K_inv ray, an SE(3) into RGB, and a lookup in that full mask; the bbox does not cull the depth loop. Accepted points go into per-thread std::vector<Eigen::Vector3d> buckets that together reserve Hd*Wd/4, then are copied row by row into points_depth_frame. ransac_plane_fit (ransac_iters 100, early stop at inlier ratio 0.85) allocates a residual array and a bool mask of length n_face_points on every iteration, copies inliers into a fresh matrix, and JacobiSVD-refits them. plane_inlier_mask allocates those arrays again, and the pipeline copies the inliers a second time into plane_points_3d. project_points_to_plane_2d allocates an N x 3 relative matrix and an N x 2 result; PCA centres another N x 2 copy. The distance image is built once: rasterize_points_to_mask at resolution_m 0.005 with padding_m 0.80. A face whose plane span is 1.20 m by 0.14 m has padded spans 2.8 m and 1.7400000000000002 m, so the mask is 561 by 350. close_mask clones it, runs a 5x5 elliptical MORPH_CLOSE (close_radius_px 2), then connectedComponentsWithStats and a second full-size mask. extract_boundary_mask builds another edge image. compute_distance_transform_v2 calls cv::distanceTransform with DIST_L2 and DIST_MASK_PRECISE and convertTo to CV_32FC1. These passes are smaller than the 45692-evaluation grid.

Stage 1 is a separate process. rtdetr_detector_node defaults to backend mock, and mock_pipeline.launch.py forces mock, which returns a fixed box and skips the engine copies. detector.yaml and full_pipeline.launch.py set backend tensorrt, input_size 640, max_detections 10, and no NMS. On that path image_to_rgb copies msg.data via bytes() into a 1920x1080x3 array (bgr8 then flips channels and copies again), preprocess cv2.resize to 640x640 and builds a float32 CHW ascontiguousarray of shape (1, 3, 640, 640), and TensorRTBackend.infer astype-copies that buffer, np.copyto into pinned host memory, memcpy HtoD, then copies labels, boxes, and scores back with another host reshape copy. That GPU path is upstream of the single pair on_pair already selected. geometry_core links Eigen, OpenCV core/imgproc, and OpenMP; yaml-cpp loads the camera model only in the pose-node constructor.
